operations.description: Find clients by partial name or external reference.
operations.name: find_clients

operations.description: Read one client profile by exact client ID.
operations.name: get_client

operations.description: Read scheduled sessions for one client in a bounded date range.
operations.name: get_client_schedule

operations.description: Read one planned or completed session.
operations.name: get_session

operations.description: List saved programs with filters and pagination.
operations.name: list_programs

operations.description: Read one saved program and its current revision.
operations.name: get_program

operations.description: Read bounded exercise history and progression data for one client.
operations.name: get_client_progress

operations.description: Find exercise library entries by name and optional equipment filters.
operations.name: search_exercises

operations.description: Before generating or editing program source, consult Open Workout Format specification and examples: https://github.com/jdelaire/open-workout-format/ Parse and validate Open Workout Format without saving it.
operations.name: validate_program

operations.description: Create one coach-owned exercise library entry with an Athlendra-generated custom reference. This executes immediately after OAuth consent without per-call confirmation. Use a unique idempotency key.
operations.name: create_exercise

operations.description: Update one exercise by exact exercise ID and exact version. This executes immediately after OAuth consent without per-call confirmation. Use a unique idempotency key.
operations.name: update_exercise

operations.description: Before generating or editing program source, consult Open Workout Format specification and examples: https://github.com/jdelaire/open-workout-format/ Save an unassigned program draft. This executes immediately after OAuth consent without per-call confirmation. Use a unique idempotency key.
operations.name: save_program_draft

operations.description: Add a coach-private note to a client or session. This executes immediately after OAuth consent without per-call confirmation. Use a unique idempotency key.
operations.name: add_coach_note

operations.description: Assign a saved program to a client. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. After approval, repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and returned confirmation ID. A version conflict requires rereading the targets and fresh approval.
operations.name: assign_program

operations.description: Reschedule a planned session. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. After approval, repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and returned confirmation ID. A version conflict requires rereading the session and fresh approval.
operations.name: reschedule_session

operations.description: Create one client login account. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. Approval creates the account and shows its temporary password only in Athlendra. Repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and confirmation ID to receive the non-secret result.
operations.name: create_client

operations.description: Update one client profile by exact client ID and exact version. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. After approval, repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and returned confirmation ID.
operations.name: update_client

operations.description: Revise a planned session. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. After approval, repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and returned confirmation ID. A version conflict requires rereading the session and fresh approval.
operations.name: revise_planned_session

operations.description: Delete a planned session. The first call returns an Athlendra confirmation URL. After approval, repeat the identical call with the original idempotency key and returned confirmation ID. A version conflict requires rereading the session and fresh approval.
operations.name: delete_planned_session
